name: r033_phase4_autonomous_sound_return_drive500_v1
description: R-033 production-premise successor. It retains the idle camp, sole road opportunity, loaded-map acoustic charge, and all delayed-source controls from r033_phase4_autonomous_sound_return_v1, but starts the five-member camp with no supplies. This is a durable pre-launch camp condition, not a signal, owner, route, dispatch, report, or outcome injection. It raises the ordinary production dispatch need from the retained supply-adequate control to the legitimate starvation-need input, so the unchanged drive threshold can be crossed by the scheduler itself.

save_transforms.source_summary: pre-launch empty supplies for an ordinary five-member camp; no signal or outing state is authored
